notes.title: Barbaria 1.9 - Age of ImpUnity Update
notes.notes:
[p]Too long have Imps played second fiddle to Skeletons.  Too long have they remained fodder for invading hordes of Barbarians, ignored when raiding others, and merely an afterthought of placement in realms.  Now it is their time for balance!  Welcome to the Age of Imp-Unity!  We’ve made a number of balance updates to try to make Imps more valuable relative to their placement cost, along with numerous other tweaks to try to make a wider variety of strategies viable.  Divine Hammer damage radius has been significantly reduced, we have reduced ranged damage from projectiles and bombs, boosted some weaker structures, etc.  Age rewards will be based on kills from your named Imps, and we look forward to seeing how you use those Imps to create mayhem![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New Structure: Clear Skies (Anti-projectile defense)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix incomplete replay bug introduced in Age08[/p][/*][*][p]Fix zapping weapons as they’re being sheathed[/p][/*][*][p]Shorter cooldown on Caverns of the Unknown and Ring of Champions
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes:[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Reduce Damage Radius on Divine Hammer[/p][/*][*][p]Increase Imp Health 33%[/p][/*][*][p]Boost Melee attack power, and reduce ranged damage for Imps, Zealots, and Skeletons.[/p][/*][*][p]Faster Healer intro time for anti-projectile zapping[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce Bomb Damage and radius[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce Skeleton head damage radius[/p][/*][*][p]Imp Pride Placement Cost 2 -> 3[/p][/*][*][p]Skeleton Pride Placement Cost 2 -> 3[/p][/*][*][p]Brick Over Cannon Placement Cost 2 -> 3[/p][/*][*][p]Boost Spiritual Disruption Structure[/p][/*][*][p]Increase Rejuvenation Well Heal Amount[/p][/*][*][p]Increase max Imp spawns from ReImpforcements Structure[/p][/*][*][p]Increase max Skeleton spawns from Boneyard Structure[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thoughts?  Comments?  Questions?  Join us on Discord![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/ZyGzJRQURm"]https://discord.gg/ZyGzJRQURm[/url][/p]

notes.title: Barbaria 1.7 - Age of Play Update
notes.notes:
The Age of Play Begins!

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Playground Save Slots:[/b] There are now 3 different save slots in the Playground area. Load and save different realm ideas. Want to experiment with a few tweaks to your Realm before you set it live?  Pull your Realm to your Playground and try out changes there. Have an awesome Playground idea you’ve been saving for just the right moment? Push it to be your active Realm for ranked raids.

[*][b]No Limits:[/b] Tired of the Ancient ones telling you how many Minions you can place, and restricting their placement radius? Turn on “No Limits” in the Playground and go wild! In playgrounds only, place as many tiles and items as you want. Placement distance restrictions are removed, so you can focus on creating the most awesome level you can imagine.

[*][b]Playground Level Normalization:[/b] In an effort to make Playground realms accessible and fun for players of different rankings, we have added a level normalization option to Playgrounds that will rescale item levels to match those of the attacking champion.  A player with a level 2 max champion attacking the playground will find Level 2 items, while a Level 5 champion will find Level 5 items. The option to always use your actual minion and item levels is in the Playground settings.

[*][b]Mirrored Fragment Skins: [/b] Ever wished you could flip the orientation of one of your tiles?  All Fragments now have a “Mirror” version. Drop a Fragment on the customization station to change its orientation, and then use it in your Realm or Playground for more variety.

[*][b]New Structure:[/b] Shaman Party Crashers
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Block Friendly Realm Raids: As suggested in Discord, we have blocked all friendly Realm raids to prevent players scouting realms before doing actual attacks. Playground realms will remain public.
[*]Add Krank, Cyclotaur, and additional weapon kits to Ring of Champions
[*]Fix structures placed above or below ground making crystal crush impossible
[*]Fix weekly challenge data not saving
[*]Fix realm upgrade requirements display
[*]Fix Left handed Krank bow animations
[*]Fix NPCs getting stuck in forest connector
[*]Fix collider size on Age02 statue
[*]Fix broken overlapping LODs on Zealots
[*]Fix hat LOD cutoffs
[*]Fix gladiatrix alopecia bug
[*]Remove target from organist in Batter Up

notes.title: Barbaria 1.5.1 Patch
notes.notes:
[h2]Barbaria 1.5.1 Patch Update[/h2]

[b]Caverns of the Unknown Balance Updates: [/b]
- Allies from shrines now spawn with weapons
- Shrine equipment and ally minion level increases on pace with cavern enemy level progression rather than always starting at Level 1
- Decrease difficulty jump every 4th room
- Increase random shrine drop percentage
- Increase final room violence bonus

- Divine Sword now steals a fixed 10% of the stabbing champion’s health, or all the remaining health of the enemy if the remaining health is less than 10% of the stabbing champion’s health.

- Decrease placement radius restrictions around non-entrance fragment connectors.

- Fix allies getting destroyed when moving between areas in Caverns of the Unknown
- Fix placement cost for Cavern of Mystery Cap
- Fix Gladiatrix weapon recall not staggering Zealots and champions
- Fix spawner animation reset after replays
- Fix fragment placement overlapping caps in some situations
- Fix Test My Base replays getting uploaded and potentially causing failed replay downloads from other player attacks.

Join us on Discord and let us know what you think!
https://discord.gg/ZyGzJRQURm

notes.title: The Roguelike Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Barbaria 1.5 - Age of the Unknown[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]**New Feature: Caverns of the Unknown**[/b] - Battle through procedurally generated caverns in this new roguelike area to earn currency and compete on the leaderboard.  Buffs and bonuses found between cavern chambers grant additional health, extra arrow damage, allies, divine weapons and more to make every run unique.  Unlock 4 new cosmetic statues for your realm along the way as you venture deeper into the Unknown.
[*] [b]**New Fragment:**[/b] UTurn
[*] [b]**New Caps:**[/b] Tunnel Tower, Stairway, Cavern of Mystery
[*] [b]**New Structures:**[/b] 6 different Party Crashers - Party Crashers provide backup support on your fragment. They wait to spawn in until there are 3 or fewer allies remaining and the fragment has been activated for at least 30s (think reinforcements for your defenses). Crashers come in pairs, and will be outfitted with a random melee or ranged kit depending on the type you place.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fix Unbreakable Fences and Walls
[*] Poise System: Show poise bar beneath enemy health bar to make it easier to see when your hits will stagger an enemy.
[*] Fix moving walls starting in down position
[*] Fix Melee boost structure not saving on realm
[*] Fix Gladiatrix fighting with no weapon when trying to recall
[*] Make NPCs prefer to throw throwing axes.
[*] Fix minions getting placed in boons area

[*] Balance: Increase life steal amount when using Divine Sword

notes.title: Barbaria 1.4.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Barbaria 1.4.1 Patch Update

Merry Christmas!  We’re including a few bonus items for the mid-age patch update.

[b]** New Reward Level: Batter Up[/b] - It may not be baseball season, but in Barbaria you can now get some batting practice in while you wait. This Bonus level will drop randomly as a reward from chests, and a brick oven cannon will pitch rocks to you that you can hit back to flying targets for Violence rewards.
[b]** New Weapon: Divine Sword[/b] - When stabbing with this sword, champions can press trigger to use their Divine Juice and steal a bit of life from an enemy.
[b]** See Custom Character Names from Other Players[/b] - With the Brawns Age Update we introduced the ability to give each champion and minion a custom name and begin tracking their individual kill counts and other stats.  Now when you attack other player realms, those custom names will come through above the health bar of enemy NPCs.

Improvements and Fixes:
- Zealot placement cost decreased to 3, and slight decrease on his health/damage stats.
- Show personal bests on the scoreboard for Symphony of Violence, Batter Up, and Ring of Champions.
- Add line of sight requirements for NPC throwing and shooting, and fix some issues with ranged NPCs not attacking.
- Add Total Daily Challenges complete board at Rise N Grind station.
- Imps and Skeletons are now stabbable during idle and attacks.
- Fix named character defensive stats not updating.
- Fix boon effects not getting cleared after use.
- Fix reinforcements auto-deploying when disabled in daily challenges.
- Fix reinforcements getting hidden there and not showing up for later building.
- Fix thrown weapons falling right next to NPCs after a throw.
- Fix missing floor piece visibility from god mode on Over Under fragment.
- Prevent Marauder’s Blade from stabbing.

notes.title: Barbaria 1.4 - The Brawns Age Update
notes.notes:
[i]The Brawns Age[/i] has begun in Barbaria, with character naming, new skill bonuses to unlock at the gym, and more!

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Training at the Gym:[/b] Place a champion or minion on one of the workout stations in Bar-bell-baria to train and get temporary skill point boosts to your attack damage, defensive resistance, or divine juice recharge rate.  Training lasts through the end of the age. Everyone can train up to 3 times per age depending on how many of the 3 Gym areas are unlocked.
[*][b]Character Naming and Stat Tracking:[/b] The Tower of Administration allows you to rename any of your champions or minions. Names will appear above their health bars in battle. Named characters will get their kill counts, battles participated, and battles won on both attack and defense recorded for posterity. See character stats by pulling up the info panel above characters, and find the Tower of Administration near the front ledge of the Stronghold.
[*][b]Brawns Age Reward: [/b]At the end of the age, a cosmetic statue will be rewarded based on how many total kills are made by the named minions and champions on your team. Only named champions and minions count towards this total, so get to the Tower of Administration, name some guys, and get to the battle!
[*][b]Human Shielding: [/b]Grab Imps and hold them in front of you to block arrows, rocks, and weapon hits from others.
[*][b]Pummeling: [/b]Held NPCs won't escape for 10s, giving you time to bash and do more damage to them before letting go.
[*][b]Divine Crush: [/b]Press trigger to use divine juice when crushing power crystals to instantly crush them.
[*][b]3 new boons: [/b]Bonus Mightiness, Bonus Currency, Bonus Loot
[/list]
[h2]Improvements and Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Embedded arrows and throwing axes now dislodge and drop to the ground when hit.
[*]Added Level icon and tooltip to capacity UI above fragments to help make more clear that fragments can also be upgraded.
[*]Added manual save button when editing realm.
[*]Increase frequency of Symphony of Violence drops.
[*]Fix allies stealing crystal from player.
[*]Fix arrows bouncing off NPC archers.
[*]Fix rare “invisible wall” on Skeleton spawner fragment.
[*]Fix enemies not destroying cannon crystals.
[/list]

[h3]Patch Update 1.4.0.20893[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fix Gladiatrix taking damage when recalling weapon sometimes
[*]Fix Zealots disappearing at certain distances
[*]Fix NPC archers picking up rocks instead of shooting

notes.title: Barbaria - Age of Expression Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Barbaria 1.2 - The Age of Expression[/h1]

The [i]Age of Retribution[/i] has ended and the [i]Age of Expression[/i] begins! We’ve added 6 new structures, a new item type (Fragment caps), and lots of new customization options so you can expand your realms and make them uniquely your own.

[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Cosmetics and Customization:[/b] Take your champions and minions to the customization station to chose alternate outfits, skin tones, and pick your Taunts.  Unlock new skins for your statues.

[*] [b]Friendly Attack Replays:[/b] Carnage Carnival allows you to search for other players by name and attack their Realm or Playground in an unranked mode. These attacks now generate notifications and will send replays to those you attack.

[*][b] New Item Type:[/b] Fragment Caps. Place fragment caps on unused connection points in your realm for extra piece placement possibilities.

[*][b] Taunts:[/b] Choose an animated taunt for your champion to perform during replay notifications after successful attacks.

[*][b] New Structures:[/b] Archery Boost, Melee Boost, Defense Boost, Speed Boost, Ruined Wall, Bait.

[*][b] Look Ma, Both Hands![/b] Equip weapons to left, right, or both hands on champions.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements, Balance Changes, and Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add 2 more reinforcements slots for a total of 4.
[*] Add Auto-deploy Reinforcements option (defaults to on)
[*] Add “No Turn” Option for Quest players who want to physically turn only
[*] 10min limit on 4 tile realms
[*] Show affect radius around relevant structures when placing
[*] Max Fragment placement capacity per tile set to 24 (max level + 2 feasts)
[*] Players can unlock 2 additional Outdoor Dining structures for a total of 4
[*] Fix reinforcements getting respawned onto the stands after they die
[*] Various bug fixes and polish improvements
[/list]
Suggestions, Questions or comments? Join us on Discord!

notes.title: Barbaria - Age of Retribution Update
notes.notes:
We’re excited to be releasing our first major content update since launch!

We have a number of new features, improvements, and bug fixes that should bring better balance for late game players and improve the experience overall.  Details are below!

Thank you to everyone on our [url=https://discord.gg/ZyGzJRQURm]Discord[/url] for all of the great suggestions and bug reports.  Please keep the feedback coming, and we’re looking forward to seeing what you all build in the Age of Retribution!

-Andrew & David

[h1]Barbaria 1.1 - Age of Retribution Update[/h1]

[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Ages System:[/b] The [i]First Age[/i] has ended, and the [i]Age of Retribution[/i] has begun!  Every few months, a new [i]Age[/i] will dawn in Barbaria.  Participants in each age will be rewarded with a statue for their participation, and trophies based on their Mightiness and Fortitude level at the end of the age. Your trophies will be displayed at the entrance of your Realm to show off your previous Mighty deeds to other players.  Additionally, there will be a tiered soft reset on Mightiness and Fortitude scores each age, so prepare for lots of new attacks and be ready to prove yourself in the new age.

[*] [b]Revenge Attacks:[/b]  When a player is attacked, their attacker’s realm becomes available on the map for a Revenge Attack. When a player takes revenge, the player they took revenge on gets a notification with a replay.  During the [i]Age of Retribution[/i] all Revenge attacks receive a currency bonus.

[*] [b]New Weapons:[/b] Divine Hammer, Axe of Retribution, Marauder’s Shield

[*] [b]New Fragment:[/b] Over Under

[*] [b]New Structures:[/b] Crystal Protector, Breakable Wall, Additional Weapon Racks
[/list]

[h3]New AI Behaviors:[/h3]

[list]
[*] NPC Crystal Crushing: Ally minions will now crush crystals when there are no higher priority enemies that they can target.

[*] NPCs advance to the next Fragment: Once a tile is cleared, NPCs will advance to the entrance of the next Fragment so they can enter along with the player.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements and Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies jump to active tile when they get knocked off
[*] Reduce Friendly fire damage from 20% to 10%
[*] Reduce moving wall closed time from 10s to 6s
[*] Add field of view marker lines for the cannon
[*] Larger no-placement zone at entrances to prevent overload when walking onto fragments
[*] Moving Walls now have a placement cost of 1
[*] Increase Ancient Power recharge rate
[*] Balance updates to Brick Oven Cannon, Imp Pride, Skeleton Pride, and Spawner structures.
[*] Increase size of Cyclotaur placement radius and increase his run speed
[*] Fix Cyclotaur helmet spawning at feet
[*] Fix Cyclotaur ancient power color highlighting
[*] Fix Cyclotaur ally and bamboozle indicators
[*] Fix Cyclotaur and Gladiatrix arrow embeds
[*] Fix minions with charged harvester getting stuck when there is no enemy
[*] Fix non-attached floating crystals
[*] Fix navigation on Four Spikes fragment
[*] Fix items catching on fire in Stronghold when not in combat
[*] Fix unbreakable fences
[*] Fix arms getting frozen in front of player
[*] Fix character movement when an NPC is standing on level above
[*] Various other performance and polish improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Barbaria 1.0 Launch!
notes.notes:
Barbaria officially launches today!  For those who have been with us a while, we’ve added a new champion, minion, and weapon, a swathe of bug-fixes and improvements, and there will now be crossplay with Quest2 players.

To all our Early Access Players: THANK YOU!  Your feedback has been so valuable to us, and you all have been instrumental in helping us to balance the game and bring it to where it is today.  Although this release marks our exit from Early Access and into “full launch” mode, we plan to continue regular content updates, balance improvements, and fixes moving forward.  

Please keep the feedback coming in [url=https://discord.gg/ZyGzJRQURm]our discord[/url] or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1984610/discussions/] community forum [/url], and we can’t wait to see what you all build in Barbaria!

-Andrew & David



[h2]Update Details[/h2]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Champion: Krank – Krank’s “Overload” divine juice power creates an energy bomb that will temporarily disable enemy structures where it explodes.
[*] New Minion: Cyclotaur – Half cyclops, half minotaur, totally into smashing things. Cyclotaur moves slowly, but packs a wallop and can destroy traps and moving walls.
[*] New Weapon: Sword – Did we really make it all the way through early access without a basic sword? Slice and stab enemies with the pointy end.
[*] Cross-play with Quest2 players!
[/list]

[h3]Improvements and Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Gladiatrix Recall now has energy pulse that knocks back nearby enemies
[*]Carnival: Add Recent Players List
[*]Fix Steam VR Guardian not showing up on Index
[*]Endless Onslaught: Enemy wave difficulty can now increase past Level 5
[*]Matchmaking: Realm options on the map now reset after each attack to use your most recent Mightiness score and get better matches.
[*]Various other Performance, Presentation, and Bug fixes
[/list]

[h3]Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replay Backwards Compatibility: In order to facilitate replay crossplay across platforms, we had to make a breaking change to our replay format.  We don’t block the ability to pull up old replays from the replay stations, but Early Access players will likely notice some connectors/structures out of place if going back to review previous conquests created with the Early Access builds.

[*] Virtual Desktop: PCVR Players accessing the game through Virtual Desktop on a Quest headset may notice throw targeting and velocity issues if they turn their bodies during the initial boot flow and view recentering.  Hold down the Oculus button on your right controller for 3s to recenter your view through the Quest system after booting to the Stronghold to fix throw velocities.
[/list]

notes.title: Barbaria 0.9.4 Content Update
notes.notes:
Barbaria 0.9.4 Content Update

- New Champion: Gladiatrix
- New Structures: Imp Boost, Weapon Racks
- 2 New Tiles
- 5 New Statues
- Champion Powers: Each champion now has a special power they can perform using their Divine Juice which refills over time.  Unlocks after a few multiplayer wins.
- Hammr: “Meathook” - Activate an unblockable punch to stagger enemies with shields and send them flying.
- Gladiatrix: Weapon Recall - Activate while making a fist to recall the last weapon you threw!

Improvements and fixes:

- Significantly reduced friendly fire damage
- Player controlled characters no longer catch on fire (flames will not kick you out)
- Extra time on larger bases: 3 tile bases get +1min to complete (6 minutes total), and 4 tile bases get +2 minutes (7 minutes total). 
- Embedded flaming arrows eventually burn up so NPCs won’t get stuck on fire forever
- NPCs attack breakable fences
- More responsive body turning for wireless players

AI Improvements:
- Ally NPCs try harder to avoid hitting the player
- NPC shooters and throwers look for new targets and move locally to try to find better line of sight.
- NPCs fan out when entering a tile
- NPCs should move off a trap after getting hit by it
- Use path distance instead of as the crow flies to prioritize NPC targets when appropriate

Balance:
- Make shields easier to break
- Decrease Shaman health and damage
- Shamans take damage when their own fireball is redirected at them
- Durability adjustments
- Block placement on connectors between tiles. Current placements unaffected.

Other Fixes and Improvements:
- Show “New Inventory Coming Soon” message instead of empty slot in Store after purchase
- Stop displaying store items that you cannot purchase because you are at item limits
- Prevent grabbing characters and structures of of tiles on the upgrade station
- Make tile connector grabbing easier
- Improved arrow grabbing: Adjust grab position requirements to prevent unwanted arrow grabs
- Increase end round time from 2s -> 4s
- Matchmaking: Wait to pull new MP levels until after player’s Mightiness has updated so the new level’s will be more appropriate.
- Fix Shamans not taking damage on meteor strike
- Fix giant arrow floating in Stronghold.
- Fix items discarded by player being destroyed upon reinhabit
- Rumble when punching breakable wall
- Fix guys doing extra melee attack after they kill a guy
- Fix bug with Zealots getting stuck in throw ability
- Fix Internet is Down message getting stuck on
- Added default WMR controller bindings (tested on Samsung Odyssey)
- Add instructions to check steam vr controller bindings if no controllers detected
- Various other fixes and polish improvement
